title: Old High German
description: Earliest stage of the German language
extract: Old High German is the earliest stage of the German language, conventionally identified as the period from around 500/750 to 1050. Rather than representing a single supra-regional form of German, Old High German encompasses the numerous West Germanic dialects that had undergone the set of consonantal changes called the Second Sound Shift.
extract_html: Old High German is the earliest stage of the German language, conventionally identified as the period from around 500/750 to 1050.
